coverage: The table lists selected differences from MAM in prose verses.
The completed scan review covers stress helpers already present in MAM’s prose verses. It excludes a search for helpers absent from MAM and optional helpers in poetic verses.

The follow-up found differences from MAM at four additional verses. It completed all 10,223 pending scan checks, counting each occurrence in each edition separately. Both editions differ from MAM at 2Chr 20:27, which the earlier comparison had marked as an agreement in each edition. Koren differs from MAM at the other three verses.

source_notes.text: The comparison incorporates the Hebrew Wikisource correction at 2Sam 4:6. Koren, the Simanim Tanakh and corrected MAM have the telisha gedolah helper on the first he in וְ֠הֵ֠נָּה. The checked-in MAM-with-doc text still has the helper on nun.
